name: Uchuu no Stellvia
source:
In 2167, a supernova explosion engulfed the Earth with a wave of electromagnetic energy, turning the sky green and causing countless disasters. After recovering from that first wave, humanity started putting up defences to protect itself, and by the year 2356, a network of six orbiting space stations, the Foundations, now guards the Earth from a second supernova wave that is expected to arrive later that year. Each Foundation houses a high school for promising young space cadets, and eager 15-year-old Katase Shima has just been accepted to Stellvia, the second Foundation. Making friends, going to class, learning to pilot a light spacecraft — it is all part of the high school experience, hundreds of miles above Earth aboard space station Stellvia.

In the PlayStation 2 game, the player assumes the role of a new student who has enrolled at the Stellvia Space Station Foundation. Each day he assigns various commands on what to do such as studying or resting in the same type of gameplay that Tokimeki Memorial has except for weekends since there is no school then. At the weekends he may invite a character on a date. There are various events to be seen in the game and there are 10 multiple endings. The game resembles the aforementioned Tokimeki Memorial game series in many ways (though in Tokimeki Memorial the player only assigns various commands for the coming week and not for each day)
translation:
2167年，一场超新星爆炸，电磁能量波吞没了地球，将天空染成了绿色，并造成了无数灾难。从第一波超新星爆发中恢复过来后，人类开始建立防御设施来保护自己，到2356年，一个由六个轨道空间站组成的网络（基金会）现在正在保护地球免受第二波超新星浪潮的影响，第二波超新星浪潮预计将于当年晚些时候到来。每个基金会都设有一所高中，招收有前途的年轻太空学员，而渴望的15岁小片濑志摩 (Katase Shima) 刚刚被第二个基金会Stellvia录取。结交朋友、上课、学习驾驶轻型航天器——这都是高中经历的一部分，在距地球数百英里的Stellvia空间站上。

在PlayStation 2游戏中，玩家扮演一名已就读于Stellvia空间站基金会的新生。每天他都会分配各种命令来做什么，例如学习或休息，游戏类型与心跳纪念馆的游戏类型相同，但周末除外，因为那时没有学校。周末他可能会邀请一个角色约会。游戏中有各种各样的事件，有10个多重结局。该游戏在很多方面类似于前面提到的心跳回忆游戏系列（尽管在心跳回忆中，玩家只分配下周的各种命令，而不是每天）
